verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy explicitly supports issuing virtual keys (per-agent) with max_budget, budget_duration, and rpm/tpm rate limits, plus key/team-scoped guardrails — directly matching the story of giving an autonomous agent its own bounded key. Docs show concrete examples (max_budget:0, budget_duration:30d, rpm_limit) and enterprise-tier key/team scoped guardrails reinforce this. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that budget enforcement reliably stops overspend in production, and no direct agent-specific case study.
